paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R Part Type: Fuel filter mount and heat shield kit Part Number: 20-0559

The Radium Engineering Fuel Filter Mount for the R35 GT-R includes a heat shield, filter mounting bracket and hardware to mount a Radium fuel filter (sold separately). The anodised aluminium bracket attaches to the chassis using existing threaded bosses, in a location well away from the hot downpipes.
hl: OEM Threaded Bosses: Bolts to existing chassis mounting points
Heat Shield: Anodised aluminium shield, mounted away from the downpipes
Stainless Hardware: All mounting hardware is stainless steel
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Filter Mounting Kit for Nissan GT-R R35
